$comment: Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD); expired entries fail CI so they get re-reviewed. onlyVia lists the top-level dependencies through which the vulnerable package may be reached.

advisories.reason: extract-zip in Puppeteer's browser downloader. The worker image skips the download (PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD) and uses Debian Chromium; never reached by the web app. Removed when the whatsapp-web.js pilot is retired for the Cloud API.
Same extract-zip path as GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3 (Puppeteer browser download, not used in production).
basic-ftp via Puppeteer's proxy-agent: only reachable when Puppeteer fetches through an ftp:// PAC proxy, which the worker never configures.
A nested zod <4.6.6 inside Puppeteer's chromium-bidi, validating CDP messages from the local Chromium. The app's own zod is 4.6.7 (patched).
